Title: MemorySmith.Agent — CI/CD Pipeline & Infrastructure
Content:
## Overview

The CI pipeline runs on GitHub Actions, performing build, test, coverage collection, and task record validation on every push to main/master/feature branches and PRs to main/master.

## Workflow: .github/workflows/ci.yml

### Triggers
- push: main, master, feature/**
- pull_request: main, master

### Job: build-and-test

Runs on ubuntu-latest with steps:
1. actions/checkout@v4
2. Setup .NET 10.0.x via actions/setup-dotnet@v4
3. dotnet restore MemorySmith.Agent.slnx
4. dotnet build --no-restore --configuration Release -p:CopilotSkipCliDownload=true
5. dotnet test --no-build --configuration Release --verbosity normal -p:CopilotSkipCliDownload=true --collect:"XPlat Code Coverage" --results-directory artifacts/TestResults with cobertura format
6. pwsh ./Scripts/Test-TaskRecords.ps1 (task record validation)

### Known Issues & Lessons

- NuGet restore requires authproxy (127.0.0.1:9081) to inject credentials into CONNECT requests
- Must override BOTH HTTPS_PROXY and https_proxy (lowercase) for dotnet to use the proxy
- Subagents may double-encode JSON in raw string literals — use regular escaped strings for any file with JSON content pushed via GitHub API
- ToolEngineTests previously used C# raw string literals that got double-encoded; fixed to regular escaped strings
- -p:CopilotSkipCliDownload=true prevents the Copilot CLI download during build (required in CI where no VS Code is present)

## Local Validation

Scripts/Validate-Repo.ps1 is the default local validation entrypoint:
- -IncludeCoverage: include code coverage
- -IncludeE2E: include end-to-end tests
- -IncludeDocs: include documentation validation

Task record validation: pwsh ./Scripts/Test-TaskRecords.ps1 (checks valid JSON, allowed statuses/priorities, unique keys, no orphan files)

## MCP Server CI

MemorySmith.Agent exposes an MCP endpoint (GET /mcp, POST /mcp with JSON-RPC). Verified tool inventory documented in stevebot-mcp-verified-baseline memory.
